data.narrative:
Aepnus Technology is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Lukas Hackl and Bilen Akuzum that has raised $10.6M to date. The sector peer universe comprises nine private companies and one public comparable (LNZA), including later-stage players such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. The stage-progression approach applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $10.6M total raised, reflecting typical step-ups from seed to the next funding stage, yielding an implied valuation of $26.5M. A peer-median approach is not viable; while nine climate and energy peers exist in the broader universe, none meet the narrow filters of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparability needed to generate a meaningful dataset of three or more direct analogues.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $23M to $30M, with a median point of $26M. This range reflects approximately 2.1x to 2.9x applied to total capital raised. The analysis is constrained by limited same-stage peer visibility in the climate and energy sector; deeper validation would require either additional seed-stage or early-stage comparables in the same subsector or materialized revenue data that would enable alternative methods. Key uncertainties include technology maturity, competitive positioning within the energy transition landscape, and near-term funding runway.
